strings.blueprint.disclosure.title: Before we write briefing markers into your game files
strings.blueprint.disclosure.lead: Markers show directly in contract titles, briefings and item descriptions which blueprints you still miss. To do that, {brand} changes one file: global.ini, the file the game uses for its text.
strings.blueprint.disclosure.optIn.title: What happens when you turn markers on
strings.blueprint.disclosure.optIn.backup: A backup of your current global.ini is created before any change. On a stock English install {brand} creates the English global.ini and adds "g_language = english" to user.cfg.
strings.blueprint.disclosure.optIn.additive: Markers are added next to the existing text; nothing is deleted. If a launcher, a translation tool or an SC update replaces the file, {brand} adds the markers again automatically.
strings.blueprint.disclosure.optIn.restore: One click removes every marker and puts the file back exactly as it was (including the English file and the user.cfg line {brand} created).
strings.blueprint.disclosure.risk.title: Terms of service and Easy Anti-Cheat: please read
strings.blueprint.disclosure.risk.localization: Changing global.ini is a localization mod, the same category community translations have used for years. CIG has not officially approved it; we are not aware of any reported bans for localization-only mods.
strings.blueprint.disclosure.risk.eac: Easy Anti-Cheat looks for cheats, not text changes. We still cannot guarantee that a future update will not treat it differently. If you want zero risk, choose "Journal only".
strings.blueprint.disclosure.journalOnly.title: Journal only
strings.blueprint.disclosure.journalOnly.body: The game files stay completely untouched. You can still track your blueprints in the journal and import them from Game.log. You can enable markers later.

strings.overlayDisplayMonitorHelp: Which monitor the overlay appears on. Auto follows the Star Citizen window — also when you move it to another monitor or plug a monitor in or out.

strings.eventsRefresh: Check for an updated event list
strings.eventsEstimatedHelp: Not announced yet — dates estimated from previous years and may change.
strings.eventsOpenLinkHelp: Opens the official RSI post in your browser.
strings.eventsEmptyActive: No event is running right now.
strings.eventsEmptyUpcoming: No upcoming events in the calendar yet.
strings.eventsEmptyPast: No past events in the calendar.
strings.eventsNextYearHint: Most recently: {name} — most events return next year.
strings.eventsOffline: offline — showing the last known list
strings.eventsLegend: Dates are calendar days in your time zone. "Estimated" dates follow the pattern of earlier years until RSI announces them.
strings.hqLiveSyncLabel: Send game events to my HQ
strings.hqLiveSyncHelp: Off by default. Needs an {brand} sign-in and the Game.log reader (started automatically).
strings.hqLiveSyncNote: Sends Game.log events (contracts, purchases, crimestat, incapacitation, insurance, refinery, blueprints, location and ship) to your own {brand} Web account so the HQ updates live. Never sent: chat, names of other players (party members are dropped), your password or tokens. Events are deleted after 90 days.
strings.hqInventoryOcrHelp: Off by default and separate from the event sync. Needs the overlay OCR.
strings.hqInventoryOcrNote: Only while an inventory, ASOP terminal or shop screen is open (armed by the Game.log or your interaction, stops after 60 s), the item list on screen is read and added to the storage of that location in your HQ. Screenshots stay in memory and are never saved or uploaded.
strings.obsEnabledHelp: Serves a small overlay page on this PC that OBS shows as a browser source. Off by default.
strings.obsNote: Shows location, ship, contract, CrimeStat and session time from Game.log on your stream. Local only (127.0.0.1) — nothing is uploaded.
strings.obsStatusRunning: Ready — no browser source connected yet
strings.obsStatusPortInUse: Port {port} is used by another program — choose a different port.
strings.obsStatusPortBlocked: Port {port} is blocked by Windows — choose a different port.
strings.obsUrlPending: URL appears once the overlay runs
strings.obsCopyHelp: Copies the full URL. In OBS: Sources → + → Browser → paste as URL.
strings.obsRevealHelp: The URL contains a secret key and is hidden so it never appears on stream.
strings.obsPreviewHelp: Opens the overlay with sample data in your browser — handy for positioning without the game running.
strings.obsRegenerateHelp: Creates a new secret URL. The old one stops working — paste the new one into OBS.
strings.obsCopied: URL copied — paste it into the OBS browser source.
strings.obsCopyFailed: Copying failed — use Show and copy the URL by hand.
strings.obsOpenFailed: The overlay is not running yet.
strings.obsRegenerated: New link created — update the URL in OBS.
strings.obsRegenerateFailed: Could not create a new link.
strings.obsPortInvalid: Port must be a number between 1024 and 65535.
strings.obsHowTo: OBS: add a Browser source, paste the URL, size about 600 × 300. Hidden fields are never sent. Location is off by default (stream sniping).
strings.eventsUnconfirmedHelp: These dates were never confirmed by RSI — the event may have run at a different time.
strings.obsPortChanged: Port changed — the URL is new: copy it again and update the OBS browser source.

strings.account.signInLead: Sign in to sync the SC Database, use AI search and back up your settings & keybindings.
strings.account.signInProvidersHint: Google, Discord or email: you choose how to sign in on {brand} Web, in your browser.

strings.account.waitingWebLead: Finish signing in to {brand} Web in your browser. This window updates on its own.
strings.account.loginError.timeout: Sign-in timed out: the browser step wasn't finished in time.

strings.account.loginError.store-write-failed: You signed in, but the session couldn't be saved on this device.

strings.account.backupToggle: Back up settings & keybindings to my {brand} Web account
strings.account.backupApiKeysNote: API keys are never uploaded; they stay on this device.
strings.account.keepsMaxSnapshotsWeb: Keeps at most {count} daily snapshots in your {brand} Web account. One snapshot per day, updated on changes; the oldest one is removed automatically.

strings.account.backupError.session: {brand} Web rejected the session. Sign out and sign in again.
strings.account.backupError.server: {brand} Web had a problem. Try again later.
strings.account.backupError.integrity: This backup can't be used (damaged or from an unsupported version).
strings.account.confirmRestoreOlder: A newer snapshot exists ({date}). Restoring this older one also overwrites your current local state, so newer changes are lost.
strings.account.confirmDeleteSnapshot: Delete the snapshot from {date} from your {brand} Web account?
strings.account.confirmDeleteAllBody: All snapshots are removed from your {brand} Web account and the backup is turned off. Your local settings stay unchanged.

strings.twitch.dialog.title: Connect Twitch
strings.twitch.dialog.why: Verse News then also shows the Twitch VODs and live streams of your creators, and the creator search finds Twitch channels.
strings.twitch.dialog.readOnly: Read-only: the app never posts, follows or chats in your name. You can disconnect at any time in this panel.
strings.twitch.dialog.step2: Click “Open twitch.tv/activate” — the Twitch page opens in your browser.
strings.twitch.dialog.step3: Sign in to Twitch there if you are asked to.
strings.twitch.dialog.step4: Enter the code shown here into the field on that page.
strings.twitch.dialog.step6: Come back here — the app notices the connection on its own.
strings.twitch.dialog.waiting: Waiting for your authorization … code valid for {time}
strings.twitch.dialog.success: Connected as {name}. Twitch VODs and live streams of your creators now appear in Verse News.
strings.twitch.dialog.expired: The code has expired. Get a new one and enter it on twitch.tv/activate.
strings.twitch.dialog.error: Twitch could not be reached. Please try again.
